settings.title: Last on, first off
settings.text: Put your jewellery on about 10 minutes after perfume, creams and sunscreen, and take it off before the gym, a swim or bed.

settings.title: Water-resistant, with care
settings.text: Washing your hands or getting caught in the rain is fine. To keep the shine for longer, take it off for the beach, the pool and hot showers, and keep it away from detergents and alcohol gel.

settings.title: Wipe and store apart
settings.text: Wipe it with a soft, dry cloth and keep each piece in its own pouch, away from sun and heat.

settings.question: Can I shower with my jewellery?
settings.answer: Your jewellery is water-resistant, so washing your hands or rain is fine. Rommanel recommends taking it off for hot showers, the beach and the pool: hot water can loosen stones, and salt and chlorine wear the gold layer faster.

settings.question: How do I clean gold-plated jewellery?
settings.answer: Wipe it gently with a soft, dry cloth. Avoid polishing cloths with chemicals, toothpaste and abrasive products.

settings.question: How do I clean sterling silver?
settings.answer: Use a silver polishing cloth and store it in a closed pouch to slow down tarnishing.
